sheets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Production pixel-art animation atlas of original adult fighter GRIS. Reference1 EXACT identity and weapon, use its bottom PIXEL ART sprites for rendering. Reference2 movement rhythms and pose mechanics only, DO NOT copy that character costume. Reference3 Ayla pixel-art sprite density/style for same fighting game. Gris has short wavy BLACK BOB HAIR, amber/gold eyes, deep crimson red sleeveless high-collar slit qipao dress with gold trim and long red fabric tails, black elbow gloves with gold bracelets, black thigh-high high-heeled boots with gold accents. EXACT SAME costume and proportions in ALL frames. She carries EXACTLY ONE oversized ORNATE GOLDEN SCISSORS, approximately1.4 times her body height, TWO long pointed gold blades, two gold loop handles, ONE central hinge, red ribbon tied near handle. The scissors MUST remain SOLID, consistent shape/size/color, visibly GRIPPED through a handle or at hinge by her RIGHT HAND in EVERY frame; hand visibly touching weapon. NEVER let scissors disappear, become a fan/sword/rod, duplicate or float loose. Preserve weapon grip through turns and attacks; rotate entire rigid scissors naturally with her forearm, open blades only in cutting contact poses; blades pivot at same hinge. Fixed side-view fighting game camera, body facing RIGHT except deliberate spin. Crisp hard pixel clusters, limited palette, selective dark outline and three-tone shading; no smooth painting or gradients. Transparent ALPHA background, no backdrop, no lighting glow, no ground, no text/labels/grid. SQUARE1024x1024 canvas. EXACTLY4 COLUMNS and4 ROWS, 16 separated full-body sprites. Each row contains4 coherent chronological poses of ONE action. Make sprites SMALL: standing body about90px tall on1024px canvas, union of body+weapon must fit within180px width and195px height in its256px cell. Every sprite has generous30px+ blank transparent gutters in ALL directions. Entire weapon, both blades, hair and feet inside own cell. No silhouette touches any other silhouette or canvas edge. Character remains same scale, no resizing per pose. Read rows top to bottom and poses left to right. Row1 four idle guard breathing poses, weapon closed upright behind forward shoulder, subtle cloth shifts. Row2 four guarded forward walking-cycle poses, scissors held upright steadily, no crossed legs. Row3 four deep crouch guard breathing poses, weapon tilted diagonally behind torso, feet stay on floor, head proportion unchanged. Row4 jump poses: rising knees bend, apex tucked, descending legs extend, landing crouch; weapon carried diagonally along side, never dropped.
